abstract: Maintains structural anchor specifications, pullout load factors, and specialized installation durations
system_message:
You are the Geotechnical engineering superintendent (GEOTECH). Your business responsibilities include maintaining structural anchor specifications, pullout load factors, specialized installation durations, and corrosion monitoring records for slope stabilization schemes along the corridor.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Corrosion monitoring（CORR）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-CORR-RA0：Under the corrosion monitoring records for the Prestressed ground anchors with sculpted shotcrete scheme, the metallurgical coating certificate indicates a nominal galvanic sacrificial layer thickness of 110 um on pre-installed subsoil tieback tendons.
GEOTECH-CORR-37L：For the Dynamic rockfall barrier fence with horizontal drain arrays scheme, the metallurgical coating certificate records a nominal galvanic sacrificial layer thickness of 85 um on pre-installed subsoil tieback tendons.
GEOTECH-CORR-XUF：The metallurgical coating certificate for the High-tensile drapery mesh with hollow-core rock bolts scheme specifies a nominal galvanic sacrificial layer thickness of 65 um hot-dip zinc galvanization on pre-installed subsoil tieback tendons.

information_points.title: Maintains structural anchor specifications, pullout load factors, and specialized installation durations（STABIL）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-STABIL-KPZ：For continuous slope stabilization works, the Dynamic rockfall barrier fence with horizontal drain arrays scheme has a specialized equipment installation duration of 42 h based on total calculated working hours for drilling, anchor grouting, and mesh hanging.
GEOTECH-STABIL-FEI：For the High-tensile drapery mesh with hollow-core rock bolts scheme, the geotechnical execution work plan calculates a specialized equipment installation duration of 54 h for continuous slope stabilization works, covering drilling, anchor grouting, and mesh hanging.
GEOTECH-STABIL-EOR：According to the geotechnical execution work plan for continuous slope stabilization works, the Prestressed ground anchors with sculpted shotcrete scheme requires a specialized equipment installation duration of 66 h across drilling, anchor grouting, and mesh hanging activities.
